netweightuom.title: Net Weight Unit of Measure
netweightuom.remarks: The unit of measurement in which the net weight is shown.

paymentterms.title: Payment Terms
paymentterms.remarks: The terms of payment for the shipment.

specialhandling.title: Special Handling
specialhandling.remarks: Any special handling instructions that are needed for the shipment.

expreceiptdate.title: Expected Receipt Date
expreceiptdate.remarks: The expected date that the items will be received.

billoflading.title: Bill of Lading
billoflading.remarks: The details of the bill of lading for the shipment.

grossweightuom.title: Gross Weight Unit of Measure
grossweightuom.remarks: The unit of measurement in which the gross weight is displayed.

freightbillnum.title: Freight Bill Number
freightbillnum.remarks: The freight bill number for the shipment.

invusenum.title: Usage
invusenum.remarks: The identifier of the inventory usage.

droppoint.title: Drop-off Point
droppoint.remarks: The precise location where the items are to be delivered.

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.remarks: The vendor that is associated with the shipment.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site of the organization that is associated with the shipment.

shipdate.title: Shipment Date
shipdate.remarks: The date that the items were shipped. The shipment date is set when you start the shipping process by changing the status of the inventory record to Shipped.

shipto.title: Ship To
shipto.remarks: The company or division where the items are to be shipped.

shipmentnum.title: Shipment
shipmentnum.remarks: The reference number for the shipment record as provided by the supplier.

freightamount.title: Freight Amount
freightamount.remarks: The freight amount for the shipment.

carriermethod.title: Carrier Method
carriermethod.remarks: The method of shipment, such as by land or by air.

enterdate.title: ASN Date
enterdate.remarks: The date the advance shipment notification was entered.

waybillnum.title: Way Bill Number
waybillnum.remarks: The way bill number for the shipment.

fromsiteid.title: From Site
fromsiteid.remarks: The site of the organization associated with the inventory. The site information comes from the default insert site in the user's profile, which also contains information about the organization and storeroom.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization that is associated with the inventory.

numofpackages.title: Number of Packages
numofpackages.remarks: The number of packages that are in the shipment.

carrier.title: Carrier
carrier.remarks: The transportation agency that is responsible for delivering the shipment.

enterby.title: Entered by
enterby.remarks: The person who created the shipment record.

freightterms.title: Freight Terms
freightterms.remarks: The freight terms for the shipment.

grossweight.title: Gross Weight
grossweight.remarks: The gross weight of the shipment.

packingslipnum.title: Packing Slip
packingslipnum.remarks: The number of the packing slip that accompanies the shipment.

billto.title: Bill To
billto.remarks: The company or division that is to be billed for the shipment.

netweight.title: Net Weight
netweight.remarks: The net weight of the shipment.

shiptoattn.title: Attention of
shiptoattn.remarks: The person to whom the inventory items are being shipped.

carriervehiclenum.title: Carrier Vehicle
carriervehiclenum.remarks: The vehicle number of the carrier.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The current status of the shipment.
